# Aunt Atossa & Diana Barry

- [Aunt Atossa](../character/aunt-atossa.md) — Relative of — [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md) — father's aunt · since v3  <sub>[v3 ch.Life P18](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0018)</sub>

## Shared scenes

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returns to [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) and notices changes, including Ruby Gillis's failing health due to illness. On their way to visit Ruby, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) stop by to see the sharp-tongued [Aunt Atossa](../character/aunt-atossa.md). Later, they visit the Gillis house, where Ruby tries to hide her illness under a facade of gaiety.
>
> — v3 · Chapter XI The Round of Life
